scopeNote: First domestic/family/intimate-partner violence evidence batch across Sound, Vision and Language. Roughly 100 assessed relevant publications was an ambition, not a quota. Search volume was not capped. Survivor, child, provider-context and perpetrator studies remain distinct. New and existing publications are reported separately.
limitations: Assessment depth varies with source access. Abstract-only and selected-methods records are not full-text appraisals.
Study-family totals are conservative linkage groups, not a verified count of every independent trial; reviews overlap and never contribute their pooled trial counts.
Two Sound theses are explicitly non-peer-reviewed exploratory evidence and receive no paper Trust Factor.
No verified double-blinded RCT was established in this batch. Publication venue and government indexing do not establish study quality.
Automated title screening is reported separately from source-inspected screening. Unscreened retrieved leads remain in the durable queue.
All evidence is pending human review. No final AI-guided chapter, approval-triggered knowledge refresh or production publication is activated.
